message.content: Based on the conversations between Li Hua and Jennifer Moore, Li Hua followed a balanced diet that included lean proteins, whole grains, lots of vegetables, and healthy fats. Additionally, Li Hua was advised to consume about 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight, which he aimed to support through his meals and possibly supplement with protein powder.
